title: EAORCS Sovereign Identity Node W3C Decentralized Identifier (DID) Document Schema v1.0
description: Formal JSON Schema defining structure for EAORCS sovereign identity nodes conforming to W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0 specification.

id.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier URI formatted as did:eaorcs:<nodeId>.

verificationMethod.description: List of cryptographic verification keys controlled by the DID subject.

id.description: DID URL referencing the specific key fragment (e.g. did:eaorcs:node-1#key-1).

publicKeyJwk.description: Public key expressed in JSON Web Key format.

publicKeyMultibase.description: Public key expressed in Multibase encoding.

publicKeyPem.description: Public key expressed in PEM format.

authentication.description: Verification methods used for node identity authentication.

assertionMethod.description: Verification methods used for signing OSAP attestation passports.

service.description: List of service endpoints published by the sovereign node.

id.description: Unique URI fragment identifying the service.

created.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of DID document creation.

updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of DID document last update.

deactivated.description: Flag indicating if the sovereign DID node has been revoked or deactivated.
